summary: Pyxis Oncology filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement terminating its at-the-market (ATM) equity program previously established under a November 26, 2025 Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners LLC. The company reduced the maximum aggregate gross sales price from $150,000,000 to $0 and confirmed no shares were ever sold under the program. The Sales Agreement itself remains in full force and effect, and new sales would require a fresh prospectus supplement. This is a routine shelf-management action freeing capacity under the Form S-3 registration statement, not a special situation; watch for a potential future offering under the same shelf.
